title: Asana, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Asana, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing the resignation of three directors (Matt Cohler, Adam D'Angelo, and Lorrie Norrington) effective at the June 8, 2026 Annual Meeting, as part of an orderly board refreshment process. The board will shrink from 10 to 7 directors, with Krista Anderson-Copperman appointed as the new Lead Independent Director.
key_points: Three directors—Matt Cohler, Adam D'Angelo, and Lorrie Norrington—resigned effective at the 2026 Annual Meeting on June 8, 2026
Board size reduced from 10 to 7 directors as a result of the departures
Krista Anderson-Copperman appointed to succeed Lorrie Norrington as Lead Independent Director
No disagreements cited; departures attributed to board refreshment, not operational or accounting issues
Adam D'Angelo is cofounder of Quora and former CTO of Facebook; not standing for re-election as a Class III director
